page.overview:
Who is Benjamin Boom Boom?

He is the patriarch of the Boom Boom Family and father of Andre and L. A.. Benjamin Boom Boom is one of the racers of the Steel Ball Run. He and his sons attempt to lure Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli into an ambush to collect a mysterious bounty on the latter's head.

Benjamin is a Stand User, sharing Tomb of the Boom between him and his two sons; each of which is able to utilize a different effect while in control of the Stand.

Benjamin appears like a big middle-aged man in his late forties and wears a hooded cloak covered with a dotted design. His most peculiar feature is the metallic apparatus covering the bottom of his face due to his broken jaw, which he can sink inside his face to change facial features.

Benjamin is a murderous and greedy man, who targets other competitors in the Steel Ball Run to get ahead and obtain the prize money.
